AI readiness check

Is your hotel ready to adopt this AI tool? Not about how AI assistants find your hotel.

For one AI tool your hotel is considering: see what you will need, answer six short steps, and get a verdict and an action plan by person. Come back when answers arrive or before signing.

Self-assessment, not legal or investment advice. Student prototype by EHL SBP Group 36 for HFTP. Questions from the project's D6 readiness research, reworded after review on 18 Nov 2026; must-haves and thresholds are the team's judgement, still to be tested with hotels.
